messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: mężczyzna (formy męskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Kosi miejskie tereny zielone w Gorzowie Wielkopolskim; zagląda do telefonu rano przed wyjazdem w teren.
- zainteresowania: ostrzenie kosiarek, obserwowanie chmur, bułki z serem
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: parking przy ulicy Fredry w Gorzowie Wielkopolskim
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Przez wiosnę sprawdza nowy sprzęt do pracy i planuje mały remont przedpokoju.
- sposób pisania: zdania: short fragments; interpunkcja: skąpa, bez przecinków; wielkie litery: all lowercase; literówki: frequent (missing diacritics, swapped letters); skróty: heavy; emoji: no
- tik językowy: kończy wpisy „tyle na dziś”

For each of the 17 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. komunikacja i dojazdy - hulajnoga / scooter na minuty (late morning, Wednesday)
2. remont i dom - zmiana dostawcy internetu (late night, Wednesday)
3. remont i dom - meble do złożenia (early morning, Thursday)
4. gry i seriale - stream ulubionego streamera (late morning, Tuesday)
5. jedzenie i gotowanie - obiad z resztek (late morning, Thursday)
6. zakupy i ceny - koszyk w aplikacji, zniżki (morning commute, Monday)
7. gry i seriale - zakup na promocji na Steamie (lunch break, Thursday)
8. pogoda - nagły deszcz (late morning, Thursday)
9. sport - siłownia, nowy rekord (late night, Saturday)
10. gry i seriale - wieczór z planszówkami (early morning, Tuesday)
11. gry i seriale - zakup na promocji na Steamie (late morning, Thursday)
12. gry i seriale - wieczór z planszówkami (evening, Tuesday)
13. komunikacja i dojazdy - remont drogi na trasie (late morning, Sunday)
14. pogoda - wiatr, burza (afternoon, Saturday)
15. gry i seriale - wieczór z planszówkami (late morning, Wednesday)
16. gry i seriale - zakup na promocji na Steamie (evening, Wednesday)
17. zakupy i ceny - drogi prąd / gaz, rachunek (early morning, Sunday)

Return a JSON array of 17 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
